_comment: Copy this to config/www/hacalendar-config/people.json on your Home Assistant
server and edit it. That directory is NOT the build output, so it survives
every upgrade -- the bundle in config/www/hacalendar/ is wiped on each build.
Each person needs a calendar entity. Create one per person under
Settings > Devices & Services > Add Integration > Local Calendar, or script
it over the REST API (see gotcha 5 in CLAUDE.md).
'id' is permanent: it is what chore completions are logged against, so
renaming it orphans that history. The display name can change freely.
'choreList' and 'calendar' are both optional -- an adult who appears in the
'who?' picker but owns no chore list simply omits choreList.
